about.desc: AudioCpp Desktop is an open-source native Windows WPF (.NET 8) desktop console for managing local audio.cpp multi-model TTS servers. It exposes standard OpenAI-compatible endpoints (/v1/audio/speech, /v1/audio/voices) for Open WebUI, SillyTavern, Legado, CloneTTS, and any OpenAI TTS client.
about.license_body:
• AudioCpp Desktop source code is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
• Inference Engine: 0xShug0/audio.cpp v0.9.6 (Apache-2.0, official binaries).
• Model Weights: Each model follows its upstream license (Apache-2.0 for Qwen3-TTS / CosyVoice 3 / VoxCPM 2 / M5-TTS; upstream non-commercial license for IndexTTS 2.5).
• No model weights or personal audio files are bundled with this application.
